Ry(t) = [ cos(t/2)  -sin(t/2) ]
        [ sin(t/2)   cos(t/2) ]

Rx(t) = [    cos(t/2)   -i*sin(t/2) ]
        [ -i*sin(t/2)      cos(t/2) ]

Rz(t) = [ e^(-it/2)      0      ]
        [    0        e^(it/2)  ]
caption: t/2, not t, inside every entry — a quirk of qubits being spin-1/2 systems.
